description:
Affected extension: custom-compaction.ex
Upstream: ctx.modelRegistry.find(provider, modelId) locates an alternative model (e.g. Gemini Flash for cheaper summarization). ctx.modelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders(model) resolves auth. Used by custom-compaction.ts to run LLM summarization with a model different from the session model.
Current workaround: summary is generated locally from preparation metadata (message count + previous_summary). No LLM call is made.
What's needed: Context must expose a model registry accessor (or a complete fn field) so extensions can enumerate available models and obtain auth credentials. This probably needs ModelRegistry integration in AgentSession / Interactive and threaded through to Context.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/custom-compaction.ts (ctx.modelRegistry.find + getApiKeyAndHeaders)
title: ctx.modelRegistry — expose model registry for alternative-model selection
